trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no separate task: finish the story, work through the 100% checklist, then clean up the side and activity trophies. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours to the platinum, all of it offline in a single playthrough.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, and it pops at the end of the mission. Play it as the game directs you; nothing to prepare.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it pops after the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, so keep playing past the chapter card and it will land.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete Chapter 2. It pops after the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, so play into the next chapter and it will land.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, so keep playing into Chapter 4.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete Chapter 4. It pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero, which is also the last story mission.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable, gold. Finish the final story mission, Starting From Zero at the end of Chapter 4. After the credits you return to free-roam, so everything left for the platinum is still open.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete the mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It is a main-story mission, so just follow the pink mission markers and it pops when the mission ends.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Main story, so it comes naturally as you play through the chapter.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4. Main story, so it comes naturally as you play through the chapter.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete Headliners in Chapter 4. Main story, so it comes naturally as you play through the chapter.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. Main story, so it comes naturally as you play through the chapter.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story, unmissable. Complete Operation Savage Glory, the Chapter 5 mission. Main story, so it comes naturally as you play through the final chapter.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold, and the hardest trophy in the set. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and progress you made during the story already counts. It is far more forgiving than true 100%: roughly 60% of the game. You need any 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, and all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests, plus any 100 optional missions. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and it is all doable in free-roam after the story.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridges flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix them however you like; under-the-bridges runs are the quickest. Track them by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so you will pass 250 on the way.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most of them come up on their own from the story and from working on the other trophies, so this usually pops without a dedicated effort.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver. Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread over 12 range locations. The medals are not brutally hard, and the ranges also feed your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger. Work through them range by range; your progress shows in the range menu.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations (42 races in total). You only need one win per location, not every race at it. The races are also part of the 100% checklist, so they are worth doing properly rather than rushing past.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you can pick the ones you like and skip the rest. Any win counts once per location, so vary the locations instead of repeating one you already won.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing challenge marked with a purple icon on the map, west of Key Lento. Go to the spot and beat Cal at fishing. It is a short quest, and it unlocks once Cal contacts you.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. There are four, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around the world. Finishing all the levels of any one of them counts; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever you enjoy most.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia only. Andy's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Finish her five quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. The quests stay available after the story.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams, when he calls you; he is the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving: he marks purple chest icons on the map, you dive, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back. Clear all 7 shipwrecks. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2-3 — as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up — so he is not missable. Track him under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Finish his five jobs — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last one. All of them stay available after the story.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count: confirmed so far are Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (the street races, including Race Against Yago in Chapter 3) and Pilot Pete (his delivery runs). Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. The strands stay open in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have done.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage, marked by the green RK icon in the west of Vice City. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; he marks some cars for you, and you can also steal them off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to see if it is on the list, then drive it back in good condition for more pay. Sports cars are common in the east of Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. It all stays open after the story.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason only. Tyrone's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers for Synthetic Labs appear in Vice City. Go to the labs and destroy them as part of Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, and finishing it pops the trophy. It all stays available after the story.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 spots in 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The trap is in Chapter 1, at Jason's house: after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning, walks out to the balcony, and you must follow her, talk to her and choose Accept. That meditation is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and PowerPyx's author earned the trophy after doing it, so do it while you can — it is the safe choice even though it is unconfirmed whether it is required. The last meditation needs both characters together, unlocked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Jason only. Bret Vogel's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Do that first quest and Bret starts marking hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. A clean one-shot kill keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. Track the hunts under Map > Activities > Target Deck — there are 15 decks, and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes naturally.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver. Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are found across Leonida; PowerPyx lists 18 card-set locations. Work through the sets one at a time and keep the ones you have finished marked off, since a set only counts when every card in it is found.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver. Use WAiNK It at 100 locations: hold up on the d-pad and R1 to scan things in the world. There are far more than 100 to find — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher Tags among them — so any 100 will do. Scan as you travel and it fills up on its own.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants any 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way there. Track them under Progress > Challenges, where each one shows a Completed checkmark. Most fill in naturally while you work on the other trophies; save the hardest ones for last and skip them, since 10 more than needed exist.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Available once you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Call your partner (hold right on the d-pad, then triangle), build a 4-star wanted level by causing carnage, then escape the red heat zone — the trophy pops when you drive out of it, not just out of the flashing search area. The easiest escape is a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic; if a helicopter chases you, shoot it down. A reliable route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters struggle to follow. It also comes naturally in the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…, since bank vault robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Available once you can play with your partner, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops back-to-back while keeping your wanted level the whole time — the red/blue flashing level, not the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing, and call your partner (hold right, then triangle). A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each, break the safe with sticky bombs, and do not leave the first store before the police arrive or it may not count. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and you only need to scan them, not drive them: open the WAiNK app (hold up on the d-pad), look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops on the way.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar at the top left. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or a wash and shower at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, then triangle) to stretch the time. Line up five enemies — criminals at gang operations work well — and drop them fast with an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556. It does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians, so pick gang enemies. Focus has four levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; by Focus level 4 it gets much easier, and it often pops naturally.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not the planes out on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get in. Go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it lands.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military Rhino tank. They are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, parked in the south of the air base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies, marked with green icons in unfogged areas. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door trips the alarm — then find the safe code on a note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver. Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to carry the briefcase in and open the vault, then go in and rob it — bring your partner and hold right to hand off a bag, since you cannot carry it all. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip about security vans (finish his earlier Payday Loans jobs first); the vans are marked purple, follow them to the bank. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to go unrecognized. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this pops on the way; each vault pays up to $205,000.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is…, counts automatically: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing the truck. You can also get it earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks, so block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. Either way, the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — fully unfog the map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the whole map is visible. It is a pure exploration trophy, so do it in chunks between other goals rather than in one sitting.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so this pops on the way. Operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang's count under Progress > Gangs.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view, and the trophy pops.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Only that blue Banshee counts — it is an easter egg nod to the Banshee from GTA III — and the pop is slightly delayed, landing after you drive further down the street.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation to blow the safe. Inside, take the luxury watch from the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 from the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. You do not need all three in one visit: if the robbery icon respawns later you can come back for the rest, so it is not missable.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check the level under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia, scrolling to Strength (heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a fitness club membership and always work out together — call your partner (hold right, then triangle) so the other character trains at the same time and you make double progress. Fitness clubs are all over Vice City (filter the map by Activities, dumbbell icon), and you can also work out at home after the story.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the trophy list to see your count, and turn on notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile, so a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives and clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent, Psycho, and Irredeemable — the last is permanent and makes cops far more aggressive, so avoid it. It mostly fills in passively through robberies and fights; if it is your last trophy, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: In the prologue Lucia robs a Payday Loans store. Come back later in the game and rob the same store again as Lucia, then get away on foot. It opens after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. Go to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City, alone as Lucia without Jason, aim at the teller just like in the prologue, take the money and run — on foot, not in a vehicle — until the trophy pops. The pop is delayed, so keep running.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go solo, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back. Next to the car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and it drops a woman it abducted — talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside to unlock the trophy. The spawn is slightly random, so it may take a few tries.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: On any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach are the easiest places to find ten people close together. Keep riding and kicking until the counter hits ten inside the minute.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies, not one delivery. It comes naturally while doing robberies for the 100% checklist; a single bank vault can hold up to $205,000.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns, car mods and tattoos. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — buy what you actually want and the total climbs on its own.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garages, $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app appears on your phone — buy them through the app. The 4 story-related garages do not count. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Buy enough garages first — each one adds parking spots for more registrations — then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.

sources.n: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
